document_fact.value: GrEnFIn: qualifying-degree/transcript documents, language proof and the dossier specified by the call; translation/authenticity/value are checked where required, and originals are verified later. For degrees from China/India/Vietnam, UniBo can accept APS as authenticity evidence; another authenticity proof accepted by UniBo can also satisfy LMU enrolment, but a German visa authority may still request APS. CLE: mandatory ID/passport, qualifying-degree/transcript evidence (Italian/English translation), and route-specific language proof; CV, motivation and references are additional funding documents, not universally mandatory for course admission. For the 28DIGITAL track: 28DIGITAL application only: degree certificate and stamped transcript in original language AND English; authorised translation where the university does not provide it. Final-year applicants provide a degree-administration statement. Also upload English proof, CV, a motivation letter (maximum two pages) and colour ID; GPA/rank statement and video are optional. Present original degree/transcript before enrolment. Specific countries require direct registrar/HEC documentation. One email-receipt paragraph still gives 2026 dates while postal instructions give 2027; those receipt deadlines need clarification. Italian DoV/CIMEA and apostille substitutions are Not confirmed. University-wide DoV/CIMEA substitution rules are Not confirmed.
